summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having bolstered the squad with several new signings and a returning player. The team showed some positive performances in recent friendlies, including a competitive match against St Helens where they learned some valuable lessons. With three brand new kits and sponsorship opportunities available, the Ramblers are ready to push for promotion this campaign.
